# Velair 1.9.0-beta.4

This beta fixes dashboard card sizing, pause-control layouts and the HVAC mode menu.

## 🚀 Improved

- Refreshed documentation translations across all nine maintained languages, including automatic card sizing guidance for Sections dashboards.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Velair cards in **Sections dashboards** now follow their content height, preventing expanded controls and additional content from overlapping the next card. Thanks to **@C2gl** for [issue #47](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/47).
- Pausing a climate no longer stretches its **Climate: status and control** card vertically. The explanation below Automatic/Manual wraps normally instead of appearing one character per line. The same correction covers other control-unavailable explanations. Thanks to **@C2gl** for [issue #48](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/48).
- The HVAC mode menu in **Climate: status and control** cards stays above Current state and other card sections, keeping its options visible and selectable. Thanks to **@C2gl** for [issue #52](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/52).

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta follows [1.9.0-beta.3](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.0-beta.3). If an existing dashboard card has a numeric `grid_options.rows` override, remove it or set it to `auto`.
- Documentation translations are AI-assisted and have not received qualified human linguistic review. Native Home Assistant themes, physical devices and Companion app layouts still need real-world validation.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app. If the previous interface remains visible, perform a hard refresh or clear the site cache.
